authoring: Genuine CMU human flip captures, exact immutable glTF bind and contact-aware retarget

source.author: Carnegie Mellon University Graphics Lab
source.license: CMU free-use terms; no direct resale of motion data
source.acknowledgement: Data obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. Database created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
source.adaptation: Trimmed capture, 30 FPS resampling, exact-bind limb-length retarget, constant heading alignment and skinned sole/hand floor corrections. Original full-body tuck, rotation, flight and landing preserved. Fingers are relaxed target bind; no captured finger motion.

armTrajectoryRepair.method: Localized shoulder-relative hand direction filtering with original radius, parallel-transported elbow pole, eased boundary blend and exact endpoint orientations; only arm quaternions change.

previewBounds.method: All 30 FPS frames; skinned default geometry samples including hair, head, hands and soles, expanded 3 cm conservatively.
